rows.text: Raises adjusted EPS guidance to high end of $2.00 to $2.40 range versus midpoint last quarter

Collins, Genesco’s Senior Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer, added, “As a result of our performance, we are raising our full-year adjusted EPS outlook to the high end of the $2.00 to $2.40 range, up from our previous midpoint of the same range.
